subject: PrivDeploy billing: prorate, SLA windows & ops credit options
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <agomez@cardinalhealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@cardinalhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Clarify prorate + ops credit for pilot expansion

Hi Hannah —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Two quick asks from procurement before we route a PO:

1) For the 3-month pilot we're doing, how do you prorate the platform fee if we scale mid-pilot (we may add a second site in month 2)?
2) We logged a two-hour service impact during the initial deploy window last week. Can you confirm available ops credit / SLA makegood for that incident?

We want something we can show legal and finance. If you can send 2–3 options (pricing-friendly + neutral + operationally conservative), that would help.

Appreciate it — Alicia
Alicia Gomez
Senior IT Sourcing, Cardinal Health Solutions
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <agomez@cardinalhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarify prorate + ops credit for pilot expansion

Hi Alicia —

Thanks — below are three practical approaches we use for pilots. I tried to keep the language concise for procurement; happy to put in a one-page addendum.

Option A — Pro-rata by active site/day (pricing-friendly)
- Platform fee billed monthly; if a new site is activated mid-month we prorate that site days and invoice the delta on next month
- SLA credits: standard SLA applies; first incident during onboarding: we offer a one-time operational credit equal to 5% of that month’s platform fee

Option B — Anchored pilot band (neutral)
- Lock a pilot band (e.g., 1–2 sites) at an agreed monthly platform fee; scaling within the band is no change, scaling beyond band triggers next band pricing
- SLA credits: standard SLA; for onboarding incidents we offer an ops retainer credit (see attachment) that offsets SRE hours for a single remediation event

Option C — Fixed pilot fee + usage true-up (operationally conservative)
- Fixed platform pilot fee for month(s) 1–3 that covers expected scale; any additional sites billed as a separate usage true-up at month end
- SLA credits: we provide a one-time service credit equal to 10% of pilot fee for incidents that meet incident criteria during onboarding

I attached a worked example (credit_workup_20261119.xlsx) with numbers based on the demo config. If you want, Marissa can sketch a formal amendment with PO wording.

Which of these aligns best with your procurement/finance playbook?

— Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Alicia Gomez <agomez@cardinalhealth.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarify prorate + ops credit for pilot expansion

Alicia —

I ran the numbers and attached the workbook. Summary:

- If you go Option A (day-by-day prorate) the financial delta for adding a second site on Day 35 of a 90-day pilot is ~6.8% over the pilot total (we show the line items in the sheet).
- Option B smooths that to a ~3% delta but requires you to accept the band cap language in the PO.
- Option C has the highest upfront fee but the smallest variable exposure for Cardinal.

Proposal for SLA / ops credit handling (practical wording to include in SOW):
- For onboarding incidents that meet our incident classification, we will issue an operational credit applied to the next invoice: 5% (Option A), 7% (Option B), or 10% (Option C).
- Credits are one-time per pilot and cannot be stacked with professional services time (to avoid double-compensation).

Next steps: if procurement prefers Option B I can draft a short amendment (SOW addendum) and circulate for legal. I attached a draft SOW (sow-privdeploy-draft-v2.pdf) that includes suggested PO language and acceptance criteria.

Marissa
Commercial Finance, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Looping in commercial — Alicia, quick commercial note to help speed approval: we can accept Option B with these concessions to make procurement comfortable:
- One-time foundational discount of 12% on the pilot platform fee (applied up-front)
- Ops retainer credit equivalent to up to 8 hours of SRE time (billed as $0 if used during the pilot)
- Standard PO language: PO + SOW v2 + SLA schedule; 30-day net payment

If you confirm accept Option B + the discount we can issue a redline SOW and generate a purchase order-ready quote. Approval from finance on the discount is already green-lighted for pilot conversions under $150k ARR (internal note).

Ben

- Can you insert a clause that the pilot band (1–2 sites) is defined by "activated" sites (not merely licensed)?
- Please confirm credits will be applied as an invoice line item (not a separate future service order).
- We need the SOW redline and DocuSign packet for PO routing by EOD Friday.

If you can update the SOW and push the DocuSign link I will route internally. We are ready to move quickly once language is in place.
